create procedure p_restock @min int
as
declare @sku varchar(20), @q int, @clean varchar(20), @cnt int, @total int
select @cnt = 0
select @total = sum(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)
declare cs cursor for
  select sku, qty from stock where qty < @min order by sku
  for read only
open cs
fetch cs into @sku, @q
while (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
begin
  select @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
  insert stock_log values (@clean, 'restock requested')
  select @cnt = @cnt + 1
  fetch cs into @sku, @q
end
close cs
DEALLOCATE cs
select @cnt as restocked, @total as total_qty
select sku, note from stock_log order by sku

create procedure p_transfer @from int, @to int, @amt int
as
declare @bal int
select @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) where id = @from
if @bal = null
begin
  RAISERROR('Account %1! has no balance', 16, 1), @from
  return 2
end
if @bal < @amt
begin
  RAISERROR('Insufficient funds in account %1!', 16, 1), @from
  return 1
end
begin tran
update acct set bal = bal - @amt where id = @from
update acct set bal = bal + @amt where id = @to
commit tran
select id, bal from acct order by id
return 0

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sku VARCHAR(20), @q INT, @clean VARCHAR(20), @cnt INT, @total INT

    SELECT @cnt = 0
    SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)

        FOR READ ONLY

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

    END

    DEALLOCATE cs

    SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
    SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku
END

AS
DECLARE @sku VARCHAR(20), @q INT, @clean VARCHAR(20), @cnt INT, @total INT

AS

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min INT
AS
DECLARE @sku VARCHAR(20), @q INT, @clean VARCHAR(20), @cnt INT, @total INT

SELECT @cnt = 0
SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)

DECLARE cs CURSOR FOR
  SELECT sku, qty FROM stock WHERE qty < @min ORDER BY sku
  FOR READ ONLY

OPEN cs
FETCH cs INTO @sku, @q

WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
  INSERT stock_log VALUES (@clean, 'restock requested')
  SELECT @cnt = @cnt + 1
  FETCH cs INTO @sku, @q
END

CLOSE cs
DEALLOCATE cs

SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku

CREATE PROCEDURE p_transfer @from INT, @to INT, @amt INT
AS

  RAISERROR ('Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)

CREATE PROCEDURE p_sum_qty
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @id int, @q int, @tot int
    SELECT @tot = 0

    DECLARE c1 CURSOR LOCAL FORWARD_ONLY FOR
        SELECT id, qty FROM item ORDER BY id
        FOR READ_ONLY

    OPEN c1
    FETCH NEXT FROM c1 INTO @id, @q
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @tot = @tot + @q
        FETCH NEXT FROM c1 INTO @id, @q
    END
    CLOSE c1
    DEALLOCATE c1

    SELECT @tot AS total
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_sales
AS
BEGIN
    -- COMPUTE ... BY is not supported in SQL Server; it is emulated by returning,
    -- for each region, the detail rows followed by a one-row sum result set.
    SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY region) AS grp,
           region, rep, amt
    INTO #s
    FROM sales;

    DECLARE @g int = 1, @max int;
    SELECT @max = MAX(grp) FROM #s;

    IF @max IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT region, rep, amt FROM #s;
        RETURN;
    END

    WHILE @g <= @max
    BEGIN
        SELECT region, rep, amt
        FROM #s
        WHERE grp = @g
        ORDER BY rep;

        SELECT SUM(amt) AS [sum]
        FROM #s
        WHERE grp = @g;

        SET @g = @g + 1;
    END
END
GO

    -- The per-region subtotal is emulated as an extra row after each region's

    SELECT region, rep, amt

        UNION ALL
        SELECT region, NULL AS rep, SUM(amt) AS amt, 1 AS sort_flag
        FROM sales
        GROUP BY region
    ) AS t

END

AS
BEGIN
    IF @amt > @bal
    BEGIN
        -- SQL Server user-defined errors must be >= 50000, so error number 20001 cannot be kept; this raises 50000.

        RAISERROR('Insufficient funds', 16, 1);
        RETURN 1;
    END

    SELECT @bal - @amt AS new_bal;
    RETURN 0;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sku varchar(20), @q int, @clean varchar(20), @cnt int, @total int

    SELECT @cnt = 0
    SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)

    DECLARE cs CURSOR FOR
        SELECT sku, qty FROM stock WHERE qty < @min ORDER BY sku
        FOR READ ONLY

    OPEN cs
    FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @sku, @q
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
        INSERT stock_log VALUES (@clean, 'restock requested')
        SELECT @cnt = @cnt + 1
        FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @sku, @q
    END
    CLOSE cs
    DEALLOCATE cs

    SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
    SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_transfer @from int, @to int, @amt int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @bal int

    SELECT @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE id = @from

    IF @bal IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 2
    END

    IF @bal < @amt
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Insufficient funds in account %d', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 1
    END

    BEGIN TRAN
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal - @amt WHERE id = @from
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal + @amt WHERE id = @to
    COMMIT TRAN

    SELECT id, bal FROM acct ORDER BY id
    RETURN 0
END
GO

BEGIN
    DECLARE @bal int

    SELECT @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE id = @from

    IF @bal IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 2
    END

    IF @bal < @amt
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Insufficient funds in account %d', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 1
    END

    BEGIN TRAN
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal - @amt WHERE id = @from
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal + @amt WHERE id = @to
    COMMIT TRAN

    SELECT id, bal FROM acct ORDER BY id
    RETURN 0
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_sales
AS
BEGIN
    -- COMPUTE BY is not supported in SQL Server. Detail rows and per-region
    -- subtotal rows are returned in one result set, ordered by region.
    -- is_subtotal = 1 marks the subtotal row (the ASE COMPUTE row), whose amt is sum(amt).
    SELECT region, rep, amt, is_subtotal
    FROM (
        SELECT region, rep, amt, CAST(0 AS int) AS is_subtotal
        FROM sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT region, CAST(NULL AS varchar(8000)) AS rep, SUM(amt) AS amt, CAST(1 AS int) AS is_subtotal
        FROM sales
        GROUP BY region
    ) AS t
    ORDER BY region, is_subtotal, rep;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min int
AS
DECLARE @sku varchar(20), @q int, @clean varchar(20), @cnt int, @total int
SELECT @cnt = 0
SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)
DECLARE cs CURSOR FOR
  SELECT sku, qty FROM stock WHERE qty < @min ORDER BY sku
  FOR READ ONLY
OPEN cs
FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @sku, @q
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
  INSERT stock_log VALUES (@clean, 'restock requested')
  SELECT @cnt = @cnt + 1
  FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @sku, @q
END
CLOSE cs
DEALLOCATE cs
SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_transfer @from int, @to int, @amt int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @bal int

    SELECT @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE id = @from

    IF @bal IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 2
    END

    IF @bal < @amt
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Insufficient funds in account %d', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 1
    END

    BEGIN TRAN
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal - @amt WHERE id = @from
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal + @amt WHERE id = @to
    COMMIT TRAN

    SELECT id, bal FROM acct ORDER BY id
    RETURN 0
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sku varchar(20), @q int, @clean varchar(20), @cnt int, @total int
    SELECT @cnt = 0
    SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)
    DECLARE cs CURSOR LOCAL FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
        SELECT sku, qty FROM stock WHERE qty < @min ORDER BY sku
    OPEN cs
    FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @sku, @q
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
        INSERT stock_log VALUES (@clean, 'restock requested')
        SELECT @cnt = @cnt + 1
        FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @sku, @q
    END
    CLOSE cs
    DEALLOCATE cs
    SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
    SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE p_transfer @from int, @to int, @amt int
AS
DECLARE @bal int
SELECT @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE id = @from
IF @bal IS NULL
BEGIN
  RAISERROR('Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)
  RETURN 2
END
IF @bal < @amt
BEGIN
  RAISERROR('Insufficient funds in account %d', 16, 1, @from)
  RETURN 1
END
BEGIN TRAN
UPDATE acct SET bal = bal - @amt WHERE id = @from
UPDATE acct SET bal = bal + @amt WHERE id = @to
COMMIT TRAN
SELECT id, bal FROM acct ORDER BY id
RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE p_transfer @from int, @to int, @amt int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @bal int
    SELECT @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE id = @from
    IF @bal IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 2
    END
    IF @bal < @amt
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Insufficient funds in account %d', 16, 1, @from)
        RETURN 1
    END
    BEGIN TRAN
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal - @amt WHERE id = @from
    UPDATE acct SET bal = bal + @amt WHERE id = @to
    COMMIT TRAN
    SELECT id, bal FROM acct ORDER BY id
    RETURN 0
END
GO
